title: Full cook all ledger maps into active Linux package
objective: Run a clean Linux UAT cook/stage/package/archive for every docs/environment_ledger.json environment with a non-null unreal_map_path, then verify archive and staged paks contain .umap and .uexp entries for every cooked ledger map.
instructions: Use docs/environment_ledger.json as the source of truth for map paths. Include every environment with a non-null unreal_map_path; skip only source-only entries whose unreal_map_path is null.

Run the cook through tools/run_uat.py with the configured Unreal engine directory /home/yashturkar/Linux_Unreal_Engine_5.5.4, using a clean archive/stage/package/pak flow equivalent to prior successful cooks.

This is a long-running local process; run it in tmux or an equivalent monitorable shell, capture logs under .control-tower/runs with a timestamped directory, and report the attach command if still running.

After UAT completes, verify both active paks: cpp/unreal_projects/SpearSim/Standalone-Development/Linux/SpearSim/Content/Paks/SpearSim-Linux.pak and cpp/unreal_projects/SpearSim/Saved/StagedBuilds/Linux/SpearSim/Content/Paks/SpearSim-Linux.pak.
Use UnrealPak -List or equivalent to confirm each target map has both .umap and .uexp entries in both paks.
Do not modify product code or Git state. If the cook fails, preserve logs and identify the first failing map or asset error.
expected_outputs: UAT command executed, run directory, log paths, tmux/session info if applicable, and final UAT exit status.
A per-map coverage table for archive and staged paks after the cook.
Clear retry guidance for user-facing spear commands once the package is complete.
definition_of_done: All non-null ledger map paths have either been successfully cooked into both active paks or the failure is clearly diagnosed with logs and first failing cause.
